title: Soviet Phobos probe's last image before shutdown

tellings.quote:
The last image shows an object like
a fin on the tail of a plane, it
looks like it's in the photo.

plain: In 1989 a Soviet space probe sent to Phobos, one of the moons of Mars, is said to have sent back one last picture before it went dead, and that picture shows something strange. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source: he says the last image shows an object shaped "like a fin on the tail of a plane" that seems to be right there in the photo. If that is so, something unexplained was near Mars when the probe stopped working.
